senses.gloss: plīha, m. (= Skt. plīhan), spleen: ˚haḥ Mvy 〔4021〕 = Tib. mchin pa, acc. to Jä. liver; Chin. also liver.
plīhaka, m. (cf. Pali pihaka), = prec.: ˚kaḥ Śikṣ 〔209.9〕 (prose).
Plīhakānanda, n. of a Buddhist monk: MSV 〔ii.96.10〕 (Tib. cited as mchin nad can, having liver-disease); see plīha.
